title: The instructions Key
description: A one-key block that names extra files for opencode to load alongside AGENTS.md, which opencode discovers on its own.

steps.description: The `instructions` key names additional files to load alongside `AGENTS.md`. `AGENTS.md` is discovered on its own; everything else you want in context has to be listed.
The array lists two files: `CHARTER.md` and `.ai/MEMORY.md`. The page notes it accepts paths and globs.

steps.question: The page says AGENTS.md is discovered, and everything else you want in context has to be what?
